major.summary: The plan must explicitly prove the existing shared Run contract already admits monthly_review.
major.recommendation: Cite and verify the existing shared TypeScript and dual-provider representations; clarify that no schema change means no contract or migration change is needed.

major.summary: The pre-claim version check leaves a slot-occupancy race.
major.recommendation: Qualify the row returned by claimManualRun after the atomic insert/read before replay or execution.

major.summary: Timezone consistency across due state and report recovery needs an explicit policy.
major.recommendation: State the due queue's Plan-frozen timezone semantics and classify report settings/coordinate drift without combining it into a coherent snapshot claim.

major.summary: A returned existing report must match the frozen period and timezone before it counts as success.
major.recommendation: Compare all returned report coordinate fields and add a mismatch regression.

major.summary: A hard crash can leave the manually claimed envelope running.
major.recommendation: Define recovery or explicitly bound the inherited non-resumable manual-attempt behavior and verify truthful replay/new-attempt handling.

do_not_change.summary: Do not add PostgreSQL-only coverage unless implementation introduces new SQL, schema, repository or provider-conditional behavior.
do_not_change.recommendation: Continue relying on existing dual-provider persistence tests for a service-only composition.
